item.title: Bremen Troopers Receive New Tool To Combat Impaired Driving
item.description: On Friday, Jan. 9, five Indiana state troopers at the Bremen Post and one from the Toll Road Post received a new and enhanced tool to help combat drugged and impaired driving.

item.title: Indiana Employers Face Contract Ban Under Immigrant Work Eligibility Bill
item.description: A bill to close “loopholes” in Indiana’s employment eligibility verification law could bar employers who purposefully flout the requirements from taking part in public works projects for a year.

item.title: Yakym Votes To Advance Bill That Aims To Cut ‘Waste’
item.description: On Thursday, Jan. 8, U.S. Rep. Rudy Yakym, Republican representing Indiana's 2nd District, voted to pass a three-bill appropriations package for fiscal year 2026.

item.title: Syracuse Public Library – Warm Up At The Friends’ Coffee Social
item.description: The Friends of the Syracuse Public Library invite the entire community to their January coffee social from 10:30 to noon Wednesday, Jan. 14, in the upstairs sitting area.

item.title: Lilly To Acquire California-Based Ventyx Biosciences For $1.2B
item.description: Eli Lilly and Company and Ventyx Biosciences, Inc., a San Diego-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing oral therapies for patients with inflammatory-mediated diseases, today announced entry into a definitive agreement for Lilly to acquire Ventyx.

item.title: Redistricting Foe Sen. Walker Changes Mind, Says He’ll Seek Reelection
item.description: Republican Sen. Greg Walker is reversing his decision to retire from the Indiana Legislature, citing the political turmoil from the congressional redistricting debate.
